quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce Completes $1 Billion Investment in Indiana, (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce completed a $1 billion, decade-long investment in its Indiana manufacturing, assembly and test facilities, the largest it has made in the United States: it modernised advanced manufacturing across the Indianapolis campus and added full engine-test capability, including new ground test facilities and an altitude test facility in West Lafayette. The campus builds future engines for the U.S. Air Force B-52 and the U.S. Army's MV-75 Cheyenne and current engines for the V-22 Osprey, the U.S. Navy's MQ-25A Stingray and the C-130J; Rolls-Royce employs approximately 3,500 people in Indianapolis. Across the United States it has invested more than $1.5 billion in facilities and nearly $2.5 billion in R&D over the past decade.
quarterly_data.figure: $1 billion Indiana investment completed; approximately 3,500 employees in Indianapolis
